commit.message:
#387 LAUNCHER-BAM-LOG-NEN-WINDOWS r1 (packet B): doi cay truoc khi bam log tren Windows bang Job Object

Truoc: _nen_do_cay_truoc_bam chi nhan Linux, nen tren Windows ham doi tra
False ngay va log_bam_cay_da_chet luon false; 9 ca r387 tu bo qua o do.

- M1: _nen_do_cay_truoc_bam nhan Linux va Windows; Darwin/nen khac giu hanh
  vi packet A (no wp387-darwin-chua-do).
- M2: vong do cua _cho_cay_chet_truoc_bam do theo nen: Linux hoi nhom tien
  trinh, Windows hoi _pid_trong_job(job); Windows thieu job la khong do duoc.
  Khong goi _cay_da_chet. Docstring khai pham vi (breakaway, khe Popen -> gan).
- M3: Windows KHONG xoa ngay ban chup prompt ke ca khi job rong (giu t71/t77).
- M4: VERSION 1.6.1 -> 1.6.2.
- M5: fixture r387 cho Windows: bat tay gan job (con cho dau job-da-gan),
  quyen so huu job ghi dung luc gan, teardown nhanh job cho job rong roi moi
  dong handle dung mot lan va khong nem, teardown co_chau=False duoi finally,
  os.killpg chi dung khi co.
- M6: 9 ca r387 mo cho Linux + Windows; (e6)-(e9), (t2)-(t6) chay moi nen;
  (a') khong nuot ghi chu teardown.
- M7: cap nhat hai neo _R387_KHOI_MOC / _R387_DONG_CAY; them 6 dot bien
  DOT_BIEN (W1-W6) va 7 dot bien DOT_BIEN_HARNESS (H1-H7).

Chua do: toan bo hanh vi Windows native (N4, N5 cua dac ta).

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
#387 packet B: ca (i) ep dong ho gia tang ngat (dong ho Windows tho)

Do native Windows tren 966ee16: ca r387_a_nen_khac_giu_moc_ket_thuc_base do
voi "ban chup con tren dia: [False, False]". Hai lan goi _bay_gio lien nhau
tra cung gia tri tren dong ho Windows, nen phep loc theo ket_thuc_utc khop
hai phan tu (ca hai False: launcher dung, fixture sai).

Sua trong fixture: gio() ep moc tra ve tang ngat (cong 1 micro giay khi
khong lon hon moc truoc). Phep so con == [False] va moi ve khac giu nguyen.
